subject: Hosted API throttle spike — urgent coordination and exec signal
messages:
From: Daniel Park <ops@aureliapay.com>
To: michael.grant@redwood.ai
Cc: sre@aureliapay.com, support@aureliapay.com
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:12:18 -0700
Subject: Spike in 429s and p99 on hosted API — seeing user impact

Michael —

We started seeing a sharp rise in 429s and p99 latency on our integrations hitting Redwood Hosted API around 08:45 PDT. Our payment authorization flow is timing out for a subset of customers (timeouts manifesting ~10-12s). We've attached a small sample of our client-side logs and retry counts.

Quick facts:
- Traffic: ~1.6k rps to /v1/generate endpoint (avg request tokens ~420)
- Observed: 6% 429s over a 10-minute window, p99 from 220ms -> 4.8s
- Client-side retries increased by 3x after initial 429s, we suspect retry amplification

Can you confirm whether Redwood is seeing an internal throttle or a queueing event? This is customer-impacting for multiple merchants. We need immediate mitigation and a short-term operational plan.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Head of Platform, AureliaPay

Attachment: aureliapay-retry-metrics-0903.csv (CSV, 48KB)
From: michael.grant@redwood.ai <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: ops@aureliapay.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:24:02 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 429s and p99 on hosted API — seeing user impact

Thanks Daniel — sorry you're hitting this. I'm pulling traces now and looping in infra + SRE. Initial ask: can AureliaPay pause aggressive client retries (backoff/jitter) for requests to our model routes for the next 20 minutes while we triage? That will help reduce tail amplification immediately.

Laura / Rishi / Neha — can you check the hosted API rate-limiter telemetry (per-tenant token buckets + global circuit states) and the request queue lengths on the inference frontends for region us-west-2? Also please check for any recent rollout/job that changed batching parameters or kernel selection.

I'll keep Daniel posted and offer a temporary quota bump if we need it.

-Michael
Michael Grant | Account Exec (Enterprise)
Redwood Inference
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: michael.grant@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:33:40 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 429s and p99 on hosted API — seeing user impact

On it. Quick findings from the first 6 minutes of traces:
- Per-tenant rate-limiter for tenant aureliapay: hit soft limit at 08:43:11, enforcement moved to hard limit at 08:44:52.
- Frontend queues for the s-infer pool spiked (avg queue depth +180%); a subset of requests were delayed >2s before entering the GPU worker.
- There's a correlated increase in client retries from 08:45 — matching the CSV provided.

Preliminary hypothesis: throttle enforcement plus synchronized retry bursts (low jitter) created queueing at the frontends. This increased end-to-end p99 and caused further retries.

Immediate mitigation options:
1) Temporarily increase AureliaPay tenant rate limit by 2x for 30 minutes (requires sales/exec approval).
2) Short circuit long tail by routing a small percentage (~10%) of AureliaPay traffic to a lower-capacity but unconstrained dedicated pool (if available).
3) Push a rapid client-side change request: add randomized backoff/jitter.

I can open the temporary throttle override if we want to move fast.

-Laura
Laura Bennett | SRE (Hosted API)
From: michael.grant@redwood.ai <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: ops@aureliapay.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:46:10 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 429s and p99 on hosted API — proposed immediate actions

Daniel —

We have a clear picture: your client retries (low jitter) + our rate-limiter hit caused frontend queues to balloon and amplified tail latency. We can do two immediate things:
1) Temporary rate-limit override: increase your tenant bucket by 2x for 30 minutes while you implement client fixes. This requires sign-off from our revenue ops/leadership.
2) Short-term routing: divert 10% of your traffic to a separate worker pool to reduce pressure on the hot frontends. This is lower risk operationally and we can flip it in ~7 minutes.

Please pause client retries for 20 minutes while we enact (1) or (2) — even disabling retries for idempotent calls will help. If you want us to proceed with (1) we will also need an explicit confirmation that AureliaPay will apply jittered exponential backoff on the client side after we finish the window.

I'll also escalate to our leadership for the rate-limit override. Marissa / Monica — can we approve a temporary increase for AureliaPay (account DL-2026-1798)? This is time-limited (30 min) and we'll monitor.

-Michael
From: Tara Singh <sre@aureliapay.com>
To: michael.grant@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@aureliapay.com, eng-lead@aureliapay.com, billing@aureliapay.com
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:52:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 429s and p99 on hosted API — immediate mitigation

Thanks Michael — we'll pause retries immediately and push a hotfix to add jittered backoff to our client SDK (expected rollout in ~18 minutes). Please do the 10% reroute now and we'll confirm after the client change.

Also, can you temporarily mute alerts so our paging isn't flooded? We'll validate after the 30-minute window.

-Tara
Tara Singh | SRE Lead, AureliaPay

Attachment: customer-issue-email.pdf (PDF, 14KB)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: michael.grant@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 10:02:55 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API throttle spike — exec approval for temporary override

Thanks for the context. Approved: temporary 2x increase to tenant rate limit for 30 minutes and the 10% reroute. Please document the window, rollback plan, and put a hold on any model or runtime rollouts until we confirm stability.

Post-mitigation asks:
- Laura: add a short postmortem stub (1-2 paragraphs) into the incident journal.
- Rishi: confirm whether autoscaler adjustments would prevent this in the near term or if we need more deterministic admission control for hot tenants.
- Monica: coordinate with Customer Success to schedule a post-incident review with AureliaPay execs and confirm billing credit terms if appropriate.

Marissa
VP, Customer Ops
From: Samuel Ortiz <eng-lead@aureliapay.com>
To: michael.grant@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@aureliapay.com, tara.singh@aureliapay.com, priya.verma@aureliapay.com
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 10:18:09 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API throttle spike — update after mitigation window

Michael / team —

We observed the 10% reroute and the temporary throttle increase. Client-side hotfix with jitter landed at 10:05 and our retries dropped >90%. During the 30-minute window, p99 returned to baseline (~280ms) and 429s dropped to <0.5%. Please confirm when you flip the rollback.

We appreciate the quick coordination; we'll follow up to schedule the postmortem.

-Samuel Ortiz
Engineering Lead, AureliaPay

Attachment: p99_traces_0903.zip (zip, 410KB)
